  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →

      (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∃ C R, WaveMap.supportGeometry u q t C R ∧ WaveMap.supportSections u t C R) ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => WaveMap.density u (x, t)) volume) ∧
            ContinuousOn (WaveMap.density u) (WaveMap.domain n) ∧ ContinuousOn (WaveMap.densityT u) (WaveMap.domain n) →
        (∀ (x : WaveMap.X n) (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
              HasDerivAt (fun r => WaveMap.density u (x, r)) (WaveMap.densityT u (x, t)) t ∧
                WaveMap.densityT u (x, t) =
                  2 * WaveMap.timeProduct u (x, t) + 2 * ∑ j, WaveMap.mixedProduct u j (x, t)) →
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                ∃ η B R,
                  0 < η ∧
                    0 ≤ B ∧
                      0 < R ∧
                        η < t ∧
                          Integrable ((WaveMap.box n R).indicator fun x => B) volume ∧
                            ∀ (h : ℝ),
                              0 < |h| →
                                |h| < η →
                                  ∀ (x : WaveMap.X n),
                                    |WaveMap.quotient u t h x| ≤ (WaveMap.box n R).indicator (fun x => B) x) →
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ),
                  Tendsto a atTop (𝓝[≠] 0) →
                    ∀ (x : WaveMap.X n),
                      Tendsto (fun k => WaveMap.quotient u t (a k) x) atTop (𝓝 (WaveMap.densityT u (x, t)))
